body_text: Through inquiry, our learners go deep into understanding the world around them, language and literacy, mathematics, creative learning and physical development, all woven together with personal, social and emotional growth.

items.title: Language & Literacy
items.text: A language-rich world of stories, conversations, rhymes and Letterland phonics.

items.title: Mathematical Thinking
items.text: Maths everywhere, through the Singapore Math Concrete–Pictorial–Abstract progression.

items.title: Understanding the World
items.text: Themes children can touch, see, talk about, explore and enjoy.

image.alt: Boy carefully building a tower of colourful blocks

items_2.title: Physical Development
items_2.text: Strength, balance, coordination and hand control through active play and self-help routines.

items_2.title: Creative Expression
items_2.text: Art, music, dance and drama, with no single “right” way to create.

items_2.title: Personal, Social & Emotional
items_2.text: Feeling happy, safe, loved and connected, the foundation for all learning.
